model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of iterations and loss for various models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and is marked at intervals of 20000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", also has a linear scale, spans from 2.4 to 3.4, and is marked at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (navy blue, solid). All lines exhibit a decreasing trend as the number of iterations increases, starting from around 3.3-3.4 at 0 iterations and ending at approximately 2.5-2.6 at 140000 iterations. Specifically, the Vanilla line starts at around 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5, while the StrmLLM (n=64) line starts at around 3.35 and ends at approximately 2.6. The SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) lines are closely grouped, starting at around 3.3 and ending between 2.5 and 2.55. The SepLLM (n=128) line starts at around 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.55. All lines show a sharp decline in loss between 0 and 20000 iterations, followed by a more gradual decrease thereafter.
